setup: You have $[[w1]] \frac{[[n1]]}{[[den]]}$ meters of ribbon and buy $[[w2]] \frac{[[n2]]}{[[den]]}$ meters more.

steps.say: Both lengths are measured against the same denominator [[den]], so the wholes can be added directly: [[w1]] + [[w2]] = [[whole]].
The leftover sixteenths add to [[rem]] out of [[rem_den]].
